Implemented + headless-verified C64 PRG loader (home-in-base map, IO structs, KERNAL symbols). See notes.

POC complete + headless-verified (Ghidra 12.1.2). Both children done: grm-0xt (build-time c64.map compiler + .gdt/.map bundling) and grm-974 (6502 PRG loader). Acceptance (a) PRG 2-byte load-addr header read + code placed, (b) banked layout mapped, (c) IO chip registers annotated (VIC/SID/CIA/color RAM via .gdt structs), (d) struct+label defs applied — ALL verified. DESIGN REFINEMENT vs original description: original said 'use overlay spaces to represent overlapping banks'; we improved to HOME-IN-BASE (occupant selected by initial bank state = home block in BASE space; only ALTERNATES become overlays) because pure-overlay banks reproduce the #6651 dangling-reference bug — base-space code (JSR $FFD2) never consults overlay labels. Result: default bank config fully cross-referenced today (CHROUT Function@base:ffd2), pre-gib.2. Descriptor design (gib.1.2) validated as sufficient to drive real C64 analysis. Residual = refs INTO alternate/overlay banks (gib.2 context-aware resolution).

Schema/system-descriptor format validated end-to-end by the grm-1.3 POC: the compiled c64.map + c64.gdt (from machines/c64.yaml) drove a real Ghidra 12.1.2 C64 PRG import — regions, banked windows (home-in-base), IO chip structs, and KERNAL symbols all applied correctly (headless-verified, CHROUT Function@base:ffd2). Schema documented in docs/SCHEMA.md + docs/MAP_FORMAT.md. Residual schema growth (cartridge EXROM/GAME bits, .crt, flow-tracked banking) is tracked under the gib.2 line, not this design bead.
